svg.text: O

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: ur four official signatures are shown

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: on these facing pages in single-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: colour and corporate-colour ver-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: sions. Each is made up of a symbol

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: and a unique configuration of our corporate

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: typeface, Times Roman.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: is

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the Corporate signature, the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: parent signature identifying the company as a

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: single entity. Electrical operations and all

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: general functions are identified by this signa-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: ture; so are Gas or Rail operations when they

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: are to be identified as part of the entire orga-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: nization. Only one signature is used at a time.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Example

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: is

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the Gas Operations signature,

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: used when the operation is identified autono-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: mously. It is unified with the Corporate

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: signature through its identical logotype and

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the stylized ''H'' at the centre of its symbol.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: shows

svg.text: the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: B.C.Hydro

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Rail

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: signa-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: ture, used to identify that operation auto-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: nomously. The locomotive design has been

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: retained for use where recognition of "the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: BCE route" is required. It is not part of the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: signature; the two, therefore, should not be

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: put close together.

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Example

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif
ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: is

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the Formal signature, reserved

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: for highly formalized legal situations. The

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Corporate signature is sufficient for most in-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: stances, although "British Columbia Hydro

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: and Power Authority" can be added to the

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: body of the communication, in normal type-

text.font-family: ManualKit Times, ManualKit Symbols, ManualKit Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: setting, if it is deemed important to include it
